description: This Java class 'HostNameSupplier' provides functionality to retrieve the hostname for the environment. It first checks an environment variable 'HOSTNAME', and if it's not set, it attempts to get the local host's address. If it fails to do so, it throws a custom error 'DittoServiceError'.

classes.name: HostNameSupplier
classes.description: Provides hostname retrieval logic, implementing Java's Supplier<String> interface, as a singleton.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of HostNameSupplier.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the hostname by first checking environment variable, otherwise retrieves local host address.
